claim_scope: sampling diagnostic only; a sampled violation can identify a concrete float64 candidate witness, but sampled passes do not certify global nonquadratic stability

analytic_hessian_bounds.qualification: global analytic real-arithmetic bounds; trajectory eigenvalue samples only audit the float64 implementation

frame_generator.algorithm: lexicographic coordinate pairs with cyclic order/coefficient shifts and alternating signed rational Givens rotations

objective_family.name: two_rationally_rotated_log_cosh_frames
objective_family.vectorization: row-major flattening of each real matrix

operator.additive_epsilon: not_applicable; denominator uses a max floor
operator.domain: the fixed finite real matrix shapes listed in config.shapes

p4_reference.scope_boundary: p4 proves the fixed-quadratic case; this P5 run samples nonlinear objectives with changing incremental Hessian orientations

paired_trajectory_protocol.candidate_rule: nonfinite, divergence threshold, or a full resolved tail window with geometric state-separation factor above 1+candidate_growth_tolerance, or storage-rate excess above storage_rate_tolerance
paired_trajectory_protocol.qualification: candidate flags require independent replay before any claim
